Choosing a community SDK for your mobile app comes down to four tradeoffs, but most teams only weigh two before they pick.

## What a community SDK covers

Most community SDKs handle moderation, roles, and feeds. Read the [social.plus community SDK docs](https://www.social.plus/social/sdk) and compare with [Stream](https://getstream.io/) before deciding.

![Community SDK feature map]([IMAGE_URL])

### Integration effort

- Single-SDK approach
  - Fewer moving parts
  - One vendor data model
- Multi-vendor approach

1. Pick the surface you need first
2. Run a two-week pilot
3. Decide who owns moderation

## Comparison

  | Option | Effort | Data ownership |
  |---|---|---|
  | Single SDK | Low | Vendor model |
  | Multi-vendor | High | Yours |

> Ship the smallest social surface that changes a retention number.
